name: OV9281-110 Camera · Waveshare 21653
description: Supplier PCB and hole pattern; maximum drawn focus projection. Additional populated-component envelopes require fitting.

geometryEvidence.summary: PCB 25 x 23.86 x 1.6 mm; six D2.2 holes; optical axis 8.86 mm from top; D14 lens; 7.2 plus 7 to 10 mm front projection.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Lens holder square, connector body and 1 mm rear population are authored reference envelopes, not original supplier CAD. The official rear photograph identifies four bare outer mounting zones; D3.4 envelope reliefs and a D3 contact-button contract are authored, with actual pad outside diameter and rear component heights unknown. Optical entrance-pupil location remains unmeasured.
